# Hang on!

Before you submit your code for review, and possible implementation,
Please take a few minutes to make sure your code follows the [guidelines](https://github.com/ChickenSwimmer2020/Hydro-Frame/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.MD), as well as the additional requirements below.

- [ ] I have written this code myself, or have the right to submit it under Hydro-Frame's license.
- [ ] I did not copy, decompile, or derive any of this code from Adobe software, SDKs, or assets. File format code is based solely on public specifications, or my own testing.
- [ ] I did not use any form of AI-generated code.<sup><a href="#fn1">[1]</a></sup>
- [ ] My code builds cleanly without errors or warnings.
- [ ] My code does not contain any form of foul language, slurs, or false/disparaging claims about other products/persons.
- [ ] My `public` functions and `public AND/OR static` variables have comments describing what they are, what version they were added in, and their parameters.
- [ ] My classes have top-level comments explaining the purpose, and version.

<small id="fn1">[1] = AI tools can reproduce code from sources we can't verify, which may put this project's license at risk. Contributions found to include AI-generated code may be rejected.</small>
